text.name: Dusknoir

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Dark Palm
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if your opponent has 4 or more Benched Pokémon, you may choose 1 of them and shuffle that Pokémon and all cards attached to it into his or her deck. This power can't be used if Dusknoir is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hard Feelings
attacks.text: Put 5 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. Then, count the number of Prize cards your opponent has taken and put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

text.name: Gallade

attacks.name: Sonic Blade
attacks.text: Put damage counters on the Defending Pokémon until it is 50 HP away from being Knocked Out. If you do, your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic Cut
attacks.text: You may choose as many of your face-down Prize cards as you like and put them face up. If you do, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage for each Prize card you chose. (These cards remain face up for the rest of the game.)

text.flavor: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

text.name: Gardevoir

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Telepass
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your opponent's discard pile for a Supporter card and use the effect of that card as the effect of this power. (The Supporter card remains in your opponent's discard pile.) You can't use more than 1 Telepass Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Gardevoir is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Psychic Lock
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, your opponent can't use any Poké-Powers on his or her Pokémon.

text.flavor: It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life. It has the ability to see the future.

text.name: Claydol

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Cosmic Power
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose up to 2 cards from your hand and put them on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you do, draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. This power can't be used if Claydol is affected by a Special Condition.

text.flavor: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

text.name: Azelf

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Time Walk
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Azelf from your hand onto your Bench, you may look at all of your face-down Prize cards. If you do, you may choose 1 Pokémon you find there, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then, choose 1 card in your hand and put it as a Prize card face down.

attacks.name: Lock Up
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

text.flavor: Known as "The Being of Willpower," it sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

attacks.name: Take Out
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon isn't an Evolved Pokémon, that Pokémon is Knocked Out instead of damaged by this attack.

attacks.name: Hurricane Punch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: Does 60 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Machamp.

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Keystone Seal
abilities.text: As long as Spiritomb is your Active Pokémon, each player can't play any Trainer cards from his or her hand.

attacks.name: Darkness Grace
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from 1 of your Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.) If you do, put 1 damage counter on Spiritomb. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.name: Dusclops

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Trick Room
attacks.text: If you have a Stadium card in play, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage. If your opponent has a Stadium card in play, remove 2 damage counters from Dusclops.

text.flavor: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.

text.name: Uxie

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Set Up
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Uxie from your hand onto your Bench, you may draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Psychic Restore
attacks.text: You may put Uxie and all cards attached to it on the bottom of your deck in any order.

text.flavor: Known as "The Being of Knowledge," it is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

text.name: Kirlia

attacks.name: Teleportation Burst
attacks.text: You may switch Kirlia with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

text.name: Unown G

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: GUARD
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Unown G is on your Bench, you may discard all cards attached to Unown G and attach Unown G to 1 of your Pokémon as a Pokémon Tool card. As long as Unown G is attached to a Pokémon, prevent all effects of attacks, excluding damage, done to that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hidden Power
attacks.text: If Unown G has any damage counters on it, this attack's base damage is 10.

text.flavor: Shaped like an ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whose language of UNOWN came first.

text.name: Judge
effect: Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws 4 cards.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Rare Candy
effect: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 1 or Stage 2 card that evolves from that Pokémon in your hand, put that card on the Basic Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.) (If you choose a Stage 2 Pokémon in your hand, put that Pokémon on the Basic Pokémon instead of on a Stage 1 Pokémon.)

text.name: Luxury Ball
effect: Search your deck for a Pokémon (excluding Pokémon LV.X), show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If any Luxury Ball is in your discard pile, you can't play this card.

text.name: Machop
text.flavor: It hefts a GRAVELER repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

abilities.name: Reaper Cloth
abilities.text: Duskull can evolve during the turn you play it.

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking. Look at that card you chose, then have your opponent shuffle that card into his or her deck.

text.name: Expert Belt
effect: The Pokémon this card is attached to gets +20 HP and that Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). When the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 1 more Prize card.

rules.label: Pokémon Tool rule
rules.text: Attach Expert Belt to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.

text.name: Warp Point
effect: Your opponent switches 1 of his or her Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. You switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon, if any.

text.name: Bebe's Search
effect: Choose a card from your hand and put it on top of your deck. Search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. (If this is the only card in your hand, you can't play this card.)

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Ralts

attacks.name: Future Sight
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of either player's deck and put them back on top of that player's deck in any order.

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

text.flavor: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

text.name: Baltoy

attacks.name: Quick Turn
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

text.name: Call Energy
effect: Call Energy provides {Colorless} Energy. Once during your turn, if the Pokémon Call Energy is attached to is your Active Pokémon, you may search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. If you do, shuffle your deck and your turn ends.

text.name: Lucian's Assignment
effect: Move as many Energy cards attached to 1 of your Pokémon as you like to another of your Pokémon.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Moonlight Stadium
effect: The Retreat Cost for each {Psychic} and {Darkness} Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) is 0.

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: Looker's Investigation
effect: Look at your opponent's hand, then choose you or your opponent. That player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws up to 5 cards.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Night Maintenance
effect: Search your discard pile for up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

text.name: Roseanne's Research
effect: Search your deck for up to 2 in any combination of Basic Pokémon and basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Teleportation
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), choose 1 of your Active Pokémon or 1 of your Benched Pokémon and switch Gardevoir with that Pokémon. This power can't be used if Gardevoir is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Bring Down
attacks.text: Choose 1 Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) with the fewest remaining HP (excluding Gardevoir) and that Pokémon is now Knocked Out.

rules.text: Put this card onto your Active Gardevoir. Gardevoir LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Psychic Aura
abilities.text: Each of your {Psychic} Pokémon has no Weakness.

attacks.name: Deep Balance
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon for each Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.

rules.text: Put this card onto your Active Azelf. Azelf LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous Level.
